segments.text: Now, he puts this question, how this threefold mullah, how this threefold way of knowledge is
the cause of bondage, how this threefold mullah becomes the cause of knowledge, becomes
the cause of bondage. This threefold mullah, a Gyanathma, a Gyan that is Anumala,
Yonivarga is Maimala, Kalashiri is Rupasai, Kalmala. This threefold mullahs, how they give
you bondage, Gyanath is Tana Mathika, to this he puts on Sir, Mathika is the point, Mathika
is the chief conductor of this Gyanath, Mathika is the chief conductor of this knowledge,
this triple knowledge. You know triple knowledge, one knowledge is Anumala, another knowledge
is Maimala and third knowledge is Karumala. This triple way of knowledge is handled by Mathika.
Mathika means Agyata Mathika, Mata. When the universal energy is known in wrong way,
in correct way. When universal energy is known in a correct way, it is found, it is
seen, it seems to be just Swazandr Shaqti. When it is known in wrong way, it is energy of illusion.
It is called Maya Shaqti. So Mathika is both. Mathika means Agyata Mata. When that universal
energy is not known in its correct way, in correct way, if you know it, then these triple ways of bondages
are handled by this energy, this Swazandr Shaqti. So these two is your own. If you bind yourself,
it is your own free way. If you don't, if you get it out from bondage, it is your own way.
It is at your disposal. It becomes Maya Shaqti.
Swazandr Shaqti is transformed in the form of Maya Shaqti. And Maya Shaqti is transformed
in the formation of Swazandr Shaqti in the correct way of knowing. In the incorrect way of knowledge,
it is transformed in the form of Maya Shaqti. This is explained in this sutra.
